title: English-Finnish offline vocabulary starter
format: JSON objects mapping headword to a list of possible translations
source_description: Vocabulary compiled for this request from general language knowledge; it is not a complete conversion of any internet dictionary.
quality_notice: Not professionally reviewed. Translation alternatives are not context ranked. Several entries have multiple meanings. Finnish inflections and Finnish grammar are not generated.

additions.description: 174 Finnish personality/character adjectives added by the owner, in both directions. Owner translations are listed first; older different-meaning translations are kept after them.

1293 rows added by the owner (communication, social media, maths, physics, music, art, emergencies, work, renovation, time, social security, crime and law, money, nature, car repair, cosmetics, animal body parts), in both directions. New translations first; older ones kept unless identical.
